automationAttempts.observed: Two UI-driver sessions overlapped before a task was created; uiautomator exited 137. Both sessions stopped and original radios restored. This is a driver failure, not an app pass or app defect.

The first timed reminder was present in dumpsys notification --noredact at 14:57:46Z. The driver had polled default redacted output and timed out at due+30s; recovery reached the shade after the 60s ringing window and found no alert. Retry uses unredacted output only in private memory and publishes only the synthetic observation. No app-delivery failure rate or successful snooze is inferred from this attempt.

Completion cancelled the snoozed alert as expected. The driver then incorrectly expected Undo to preserve CANCELLED. Existing source policy rearms unhandled occurrences when a task is reopened; only ACKNOWLEDGED/MISSED occurrences are protected from replay. The recent original deadline rang again. No source change inferred; validate the terminal-outcome case and clarify docs.
